best_idea: A value event that restarts a short fade-and-rise popup, with the counter rolling from the old value to the new one in a shorter time, gives hit feedback that matches the number the engine sent.
decision_why: Take the popup shape (restart on each event, fade and rise, a counter roll shorter than the popup) for hit numbers; the number comes from the server-confirmed hit and the previous value is passed in. The donor decides the bonus in the client and mis-rolls a clamped subtract, which our one-ledger and server-verified rules forbid.
acceptance: A server-confirmed hit of 18 shows "-18" rising and fading over 1.5 s above the target while the health number rolls from its old value to its new value over 0.5 s; a test asserts the number comes from the server event, and a loss clamped at zero shows the true loss, not the requested amount.
